WITH fee_calculations AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    f.feesnode,
    (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net_rate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
),
scope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fee_calculations
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS plain_average
  FROM scope_averages
)
SELECT 
  s.acctscope,
  s.avg_net_rate,
  s.fee_count,
  s.avg_net_rate - o.plain_average AS difference_from_plain_average
FROM scope_averages s
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
ORDER BY s.acctscope
